subject: Implementation pact: sprint owners & cutover windows
messages:
From: Anjali Rao <anjali@falken.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@falken.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — proposing sprint commitments

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the productive kickoff yesterday. Tom and I pulled together an initial mutual action plan and a proposed set of cutover windows for our integration. Attached is the MAP spreadsheet with suggested milestone owners and tentative dates. Key asks:

- Can your CS/implementation team confirm owners for the first three sprints (API auth, data mapping, and test harness)?
- We prefer a production cutover during the week of Aug 14–18, ideally a Wednesday window. Is that workable on your side?

Quick context: Falken will provide the S3 test payloads (sample set A) and a service account for staging. We need Redwood to validate token rotation behavior and provide a short runbook for rollback.

Attachments: Falken_MAP_v1.xlsx (map with milestones), cutover_windows.png (visual of proposed blackout/cutover slots)

Thanks — look forward to your confirmation on owners so we can lock sprint commitments.

Best,
Anjali Rao
Head of Partnerships, Falken AI
(attachment: Falken_MAP_v1.xlsx - spreadsheet)
(attachment: cutover_windows.png - image)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anjali Rao <anjali@falken.ai>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@falken.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — proposing sprint commitments

Anjali / Tom —

Thanks for putting this together. I reviewed the MAP and the cutover visual. High level yes, the windows look reasonable. Below are the owner confirmations and two narrow asks from our side before we lock dates:

Confirmed owners (Redwood):
- API auth verification: Jordan Blake (jordan_blake@redwood.ai)
- Data mapping & schema validation: Mina Haddad (mina_haddad@redwood.ai)
- Staging test harness + load smoke: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)

Redwood asks:
1) Please confirm when the Falken S3 test payloads will be available in staging (we need at least 24 hours to seed caches before sprint start).
2) We request a hard freeze window for schema changes two weeks before the proposed cutover (to avoid last-minute field drift).

Proposed next steps:
- Jordan to schedule a 30-min owners sync by EOD Fri (I asked Jordan to propose times).
- Mina will draft the data mapping checklist and post it to the Drive link you shared.
- Marissa will prepare the go/no-go checklist for each cutover candidate date and attach it to the MAP.

Will update the MAP with owners and add Jira ticket CS-712 as the canonical tracker.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood_MAP_owner_updates_v1.xlsx - stub)

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Anjali Rao <anjali@falken.ai>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@falken.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Owners sync — agenda and immediate blockers

Team — quick internal note and agenda for the 30-min owners sync (proposed Fri 10:30–11:00 PT).

Agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: confirm availability for proposed sprint window (start Mon Jun 19)
- 5–15m: data contract gaps (Mina) — two fields flagged as nullable vs required
- 15–22m: staging seeding plan (Marissa) — timeline for payload ingestion and sanity checks
- 22–28m: cutover blackout mechanics and rollback runbook owner (Jordan)
- 28–30m: confirm actions + owners for next week

Immediate blocker: Falken noted they will upload sample set A on Mon Jun 12. If that slips, we push sprint start by one week. Mina, please flag the two schema fields in the Drive doc so Anjali can confirm.

Thanks — I’ll send calendar invite once Karthik confirms.

Jordan Blake
Senior Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
(attachment: invite.ics - calendar stub)

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@falken.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Anjali Rao <anjali@falken.ai>, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Jun 2028 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — proposing sprint commitments

Karthik / team —

Appreciate the quick confirmations. We will:
- Upload sample set A to the staging bucket on Mon Jun 12 (EOD PST).
- Lock down schema (we accept the two fields becoming required; will confirm via the Drive doc by Jun 11).
- Target production cutover: Wed Aug 16 (we prefer 10:00–14:00 PT window).

Tom will join the owners sync on Fri and provide a short escalation path for infra issues. If anything changes on our end I’ll update the MAP and flag CS-712 in the comment thread.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Tom Ellis
VP, Product — Falken AI
